artworks.title: Building the Argo
artworks.description: British Museum terracotta of the Argo under Athena's eye — the ship Samian Ancaeus will later steer after Tiphys dies. Not Ancaeus of Tegea, gored in the Calydonian hunt.

artworks.title: The Building of the Ship Argo
artworks.description: Rijksmuseum painting of the Argo's construction — the hull that will take Ancaeus of Samos from Parthenia to the Propontis helm.

films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Harryhausen's Argo keeps the voyage's steersmen in the crew — Samian Ancaeus among the helmsman line Apollonius names after Tiphys.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius makes Ancaeus son of Poseidon the Samian Argonaut who takes the helm after Tiphys — distinct from Arcadian Ancaeus of the Calydonian boar.

popCulture.title: Ancaeus (son of Poseidon)
popCulture.description: Samian Argonaut and helmsman — not Ancaeus son of Lycurgus of Tegea.
